The Chinese characters for Leo

As a transliteration, Leo is usually written 利奥 (Lì ào). Each character is listed below with its own dictionary meaning — the name is chosen by sound, not by meaning, and Moying does not translate names. Please have a person review the characters before any permanent use such as a tattoo.

Origin and meaning

With Latin origins, Leo is usually read as “lion”.

About the name Leo

A lion-hearted Latin name carried by thirteen popes.

As a gift or a tattoo

People often order Leo as a framed gift or as a tattoo — the meaning, “lion”, is part of the appeal.
